mapper.select: SELECT t.warning_type_id, t.warning_order_id, t.flow_id, a.msg_notify_type, a.msg_notify_limit, a.msg_notify_company, t.tenant_id, t.process_id FROM ${tableName} t, vm_flow_link_attr a WHERE t.flow_id = a.alarm_flow_id AND t.link_id = '1' AND a.cur_link = '1' AND a.msg_notify_type LIKE '%1%' AND a.msg_notify_limit IS NOT NULL AND t.warning_type_id = #{warningTypeId} AND DATE_FORMAT(t.flow_node_time ,'%Y-%m-%d') = DATE_FORMAT(now() ,'%Y-%m-%d')
SELECT type_name FROM sys_alarm_type a WHERE a.type_value = #{warningTypeId} and a.delete_flag = '0'
